description.en: Build clean pulling, pushing, leg strength, trunk control, mobility, and resilient joints.
Develop pull-over control, high pulls, support strength, and assisted transitions.
Consolidate strict muscle-ups and introduce structured lever, dragon flag, and planche work.
Own the tuck shapes, protect the joints, and keep the basic strength engine.
Build longer levers, cleaner muscle-ups, stronger dragon flags, and planche control.
Practice advanced shapes in successive waves while fundamentals remain permanent.

authentic_description.en: Authentic workout extracted from the supplied Base APK, with a newly authored preparation and stretching overlay.

catalog_notice.en: Replacement and extension sessions are newly authored and are not recovered Street Gymnastic PRO data. The app uses a balanced six-level sequence of 100 assigned workouts per level.
